description: This file implements a command-line interface commands registry, including functions for adding commands with various parameter types, help display, and command processing logic.

methods.name: resetConsoleActions
methods.description: Resets the count of registered console actions to zero.

methods.name: doAddAction
methods.description: Internal function to add a command action with validation for duplicate and case requirements.

methods.name: addConsoleActionP
methods.description: Adds a console action with no parameters, callback as VoidPtr.

methods.name: addConsoleActionSSP
methods.description: Adds a console action with string parameters, callback as VoidCharPtrCharPtrVoidPtr.

methods.name: addConsoleAction
methods.description: Adds a console command without parameters.

methods.name: addConsoleActionI
methods.description: Adds a console command with one integer parameter.

methods.name: addConsoleActionIP
methods.description: Adds a console command with one integer parameter and a callback with a parameter.

methods.name: addConsoleActionII
methods.description: Adds a console command with two integer parameters.

methods.name: addConsoleActionIIP
methods.description: Adds a console command with two integers and a callback with a parameter.

methods.name: addConsoleActionS
methods.description: Adds a console command with a string parameter.

methods.name: addConsoleActionSP
methods.description: Adds a console command with a string parameter and callback with a parameter.

methods.name: addConsoleActionSS
methods.description: Adds a console command with two string parameters.

methods.name: addConsoleActionSSS
methods.description: Adds a console command with three string parameters.

methods.name: addConsoleActionSSSSS
methods.description: Adds a console command with five string parameters.

methods.name: addConsoleActionNANF
methods.description: Adds a console command with a float parameter allowing NaN.

methods.name: addConsoleActionF
methods.description: Adds a console command with a float parameter.

methods.name: addConsoleActionFF
methods.description: Adds a console command with two float parameters.

methods.name: addConsoleActionFFP
methods.description: Adds a console command with two floats and a callback with a parameter.

methods.name: getParameterCount
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters expected based on the action type.

methods.name: helpCommand
methods.description: Prints out a list of all available commands.

methods.name: echo
methods.description: Test function that prints the received integer value.

methods.name: unquote
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a line if present.

methods.name: findEndOfToken
methods.description: Finds the end position of a token, considering quotes.

methods.name: handleActionWithParameter
methods.description: Processes a command's parameter based on its type and invokes the callback.

methods.name: tokenLength
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in the first token of a message.

methods.name: initConsoleLogic
methods.description: Initializes console logic and registers basic commands.

methods.name: validateSecureLine
methods.description: Validates secure line protocol prefix and length.

methods.name: handleConsoleLineInternal
methods.description: Processes a command line, matching it to registered actions.

methods.name: handleConsoleLine
methods.description: Main function to process a command line, including validation and response.
